environment.virtualization: Colima 0.10.1 with macOS Virtualization.Framework and virtiofs

vulnerability_scan.policy: fail on fixable HIGH or CRITICAL findings; ignore unfixed findings
hardening: upgraded Debian build and runtime packages before compilation and release assembly
removed the global npm toolchain and audit/test sources from the browser runtime after image tests
removed unused gosu from the backup runtime, which already executes as postgres

assertions: all migrations applied to a blank PostgreSQL 16 database
unauthenticated API access returned 401 and authenticated health/metrics succeeded
production assets were content-digested, public-cacheable for at least one year, and gzip encoded
HSTS was emitted behind the trusted HTTPS proxy boundary
migration service exited successfully before application start
application, browser worker, backup service, and PostgreSQL reached the expected states
all services had CPU, memory, PID, log, and no-new-privileges bounds
application, migration, browser, and backup containers used read-only roots and dropped all capabilities
application, browser, and backup containers ran as non-root users
browser control and egress networks were isolated from the database network
browser-worker smoke passed through its runtime boundary
provider environment-file injection was available only as configured
an encrypted backup was produced and structurally verified
the backup restored into a disposable database with migration ledger and core tables present

repository_gate.static_analysis: completed with only reviewed low-confidence findings

limitations: This is a local arm64 build and runtime qualification; registry push, signing, provenance attestation, target-architecture scanning, and target-host capacity remain deployment actions.
The successful disposable restore used a Docker volume on the same physical host and does not satisfy the independent off-host restore gate.
No enabled non-mock provider or production credential was available, so real-provider staging remains open.
Automated accessibility evidence does not replace the required human VoiceOver/Safari pass.
